emma: Kicked off SilverPeak POC perf smoke. baseline vs q4 at small scale, will scale later today. quick notes.
noah: target SLOs?
emma: customer wants 99p < 350ms at sustained 650 qps, peaks to 2.5k. smoke run (20m @ 300 qps, seq=72): baseline p50 66ms p95 148ms p99 310ms. q4 p50 54ms p95 165ms p99 had a few spikes ~700ms.
jin: spikes during concurrent prefix churn or AZ routing?
emma: correlated with prefix churn windows and short nvlink saturation bursts. prefetch async enabled. run command: ```./bench --model redwood-large-v1 --variant q4_0 --seq 72 --qps 300 --concurrency 10 --prefetch async --ramp 300```
noah: plan: book a ded slot for 3x30m steady runs at 650 qps across 3 AZs with synthetic prefix skew (60/40 hot/unique). one run will enable kv-pin. collect nvlink, gpu memcpy stalls, kernel eviction logs.
ops-bot: Candidate slot: ded-usw-12g available 2026-06-26 02:00-05:00 UTC.
emma: procurement asked for reserved uplift for 2.5k peak with 12% headroom vs PAYG. need ballpark by EOD.
noah: back-of-envelope: reserved+SLA ~ $26k/mo. PAYG ~ $47k/mo. if kv-pin reduces 99p tail we can recommend q4 path and estimate ~14% token cost savings.
legal: SilverPeak requested customer-managed KMS + CloudHSM for key custody. Dedicated supports this; will start BAA intake for PHI needs.
sam: I'll add memory + nvlink counters and upload traces after runs. also recommend a 5% canary fallback to baseline to protect UX during iteration.
emma: actions:
- jin/noah: run 3x30m multi-AZ soaks with kv-pin candidate in ded-usw-12g slot (target slot above)
- sam: collect nvlink/gpu memcpy, kernel eviction, page-fault histograms, and upload to perf share
- emma: send provisional reserved vs PAYG ballpark to procurement and ask for expected go-live month by EOD
- legal: start BAA intake and confirm CloudHSM checklist
ops-bot: Please confirm if you want the ded-usw-12g slot booked.
emma: booking now. will post raw CSVs + flamegraphs after runs. if we can hit 99p < 350ms at 650 qps on Dedicated with fallback, sales will push for a 12mo commit. :rocket:
